# Claims ledger (generated by analysis/ledger.py; do not edit by hand)

Every number the paper quotes must appear here (or in HEADLINE.md) with its source. Speedup = native time / mode time, same config, native *mode* as baseline. Event = GPU time (CUDA events); wall = per call with a host sync. 'Fixed' = workspace set (`*_ws`). Zero code = env var only (`*_ws0`, wall clock).
